name: fuzz_oversized_uhid
description: T-10 RCE: SourceUhid field 10,000 chars. Parser must reject without crashing.
notes: UHID must be exactly 16 chars (base-32 encoded Ed25519 public key fragment). Any parser accepting arbitrary-length UHIDs is vulnerable.

name: fuzz_negative_chunk_count
description: T-10 RCE: ChunkBitmapPayload with chunk_count=-1. Parser must reject without integer underflow.
notes: ChunkShuffleSession constructor guards chunkCount < 0 with ArgumentOutOfRangeException. Language implementations must match.

name: fuzz_null_payload
description: T-10 RCE: MeshPacket with null payload field. Parser must not NullReferenceException.
notes: Null payload must be treated as empty bytes, not crash.

name: fuzz_replay_chunk_bitmap
description: T-02 Replay: ChunkBitmapPayload with generation=0 after generation=5 has been seen. Must be silently discarded.
setup: First deliver generation=5 for peer KXJB7MN2P4TEST01
notes: ChunkShuffleSession.OnPeerBitmap generation guard: generation <= lastGen returns empty. All 8 language implementations must honour this.

name: fuzz_max_chunk_count
description: T-09 DoS: ChunkBitmapPayload with chunk_count=2147483647 (Int32.MaxValue). Parser must handle without OOM.
notes: Implementations should cap chunk_count at ProtocolConstants.MaxContentChunks. A 2 billion-element bool array allocation is a DoS vector.

name: fuzz_invalid_base64_bitset
description: T-10 RCE: ChunkBitmapPayload with non-base64 have_bitset. Parser must reject cleanly.
notes: Base64 decode errors must throw AetherProtocolException, not FormatException bubbled to caller.

name: fuzz_sybil_rapid_join
description: T-03 Sybil: 1000 HelloPayload packets from 1000 different UHIDs arriving within 100ms. IBehavioralAnomalyDetector must flag.
packet: generate 1000 HelloPayload packets with unique UHIDs within 100ms window
expected: AnomalyScore > 0.8 for all nodes, AetherSecurityEvent emitted
notes: Rapid join storm is a classic Sybil indicator. BehavioralAnomalyDetector should track join rate per time window.
